decision.question: where does the ways-out links region sit in a head row that's already busy?
options: fold as a fifth group into .v3-toolbar (view switch, Live, author filter, track width)
its own small row in .v3-head, between the title and the version picker
decision.chose: its own small row in .v3-head, between the title and the version picker
decision.why: the toolbar is view STATE (how the wall is currently sorted/filtered/sized) — mixing four navigation destinations into it would read as more toolbar controls, not an exit. The title link is already the page's one 'way home' anchor; putting ways-out right beside it groups all wayfinding in one glance, in text, at a size (0.875rem, quiet until hover) that can't compete with the toolbar's buttons or push the wall down.
decision.rule: code#4 (a new region proposes itself before it's added — name the alternative) + css skill's ladder (climb to an existing home for a thing before inventing a new one)
